sorry_inventory.statement: nf_exist_to_temporal_aux: ∃ A, ∀ M t, temporal_truth M atomMap t A ↔ ∃ x, nf_eval_nf M (k+1) 2 (x::t) sub_nf
sorry_inventory.assumption: Existence of temporal formula for depth-(k+1) arity-2 NF existentials on Prior structures
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: The proof decomposes into: (1) Atom layer — determining x < t / t < x / x = t and predicate conditions — handled sorry-free by VecEA2/NfToVecEA. (2) Quantifier layer — each arity-3 existential ∃ y, nf_eval_nf M k 3 [y,x,t] snf3 — handled at depth 0 by VecEADecomp (sorry-free), but at depth > 0 requires generalized arity reduction (Lemma 3.2). The arity tower: depth k+1 arity 2 → depth k arity 3 → depth k-1 arity 4 → ... → depth 0 arity k+3. At depth 0, VecEADecomp handles arity 3 only (897 lines); arbitrary arity at depth 0 needs generalized zone decomposition.

(2) Implement generalized depth-0 zone decomposition for arbitrary arity by induction on arity (~500-800 lines). (3) Implement lexicographic (k,n) descent composing the depth-0 base with quantifier layer reduction (~300 lines).

key_findings: The previous plan's approach (mutual structural induction on MonadicFormula at arities 1 and 2) is blocked by the arity tower: .ex at arity 2 introduces arity 3, which cannot be reduced to arity 2 without Lemma 3.2

The previous handoff's claim that 'model-independent negation closure' is needed was INCORRECT for the NF-direct approach. The restructured sorry at nf_exist_to_temporal_aux works directly with NFs and needs no MonadicFormula translation
The correct resolution path is lexicographic (k,n) descent: depth k+1 arity 2 -> depth k arity 3 -> ... -> depth 0 arity k+3, with generalized depth-0 zone decomposition as the base case

VecEADecomp.lean (897 lines) handles depth-0 arity 3. Generalizing to arbitrary arity at depth 0 is a finite combinatorial problem: enumerate orderings of m variables, decompose into pairwise 2-variable conditions
The fo_to_temporal approach via MonadicFormula is fundamentally circular when used inside the NF depth induction. The NF-direct approach (nf_exist_to_temporal_aux) avoids this circularity

resolution_path.step_1: Wire VecEADecomp zone theorems into a single nf_3var_exist_depth0_tl function that produces temporal formulas for depth-0 arity-3 existentials. All pieces exist, just need composition. ~200 lines.
resolution_path.step_2: Implement generalized depth-0 zone decomposition for arbitrary arity m by induction on m. Base cases m <= 3 use existing infrastructure. Step case m+1 adds a new variable, case-splits on its position, decomposes into pairwise VVecEA2 conditions. ~500-800 lines.
resolution_path.step_3: Implement the lexicographic (k,n) descent: at (k+1,2) use (k,3); at (k,3) use (k-1,4); ...; at (0,m) use generalized depth-0 decomposition. ~300 lines.
resolution_path.step_4: Compose the layers into nf_exist_to_temporal_aux to eliminate the sorry. ~100-200 lines.

next_action_hint: Revise plan to replace Phase 2 (arity reduction) with the three-step resolution path: (1) wire depth-0 arity-3 zones, (2) generalize to arbitrary arity at depth 0, (3) lexicographic descent. Estimate ~1000-1300 additional lines across 2-3 new files.
